setup: CREATE TABLE items AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS item_id, ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'][1 + i] AS kind FROM range(4) t(i)
CREATE TABLE buys AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS buy_id, (i % 8)::BIGINT AS user_id, ((i * 3) % 4)::BIGINT AS item_id, TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01' + to_days((i * 5)::INTEGER) AS ts FROM range(120) t(i)
input.pql: PREDICT LIST_DISTINCT(BUYS.ITEM_ID, 0, 30, days) RANK TOP 2 FOR EACH USERS.USER_ID

view.name: view_semantic_ranking
view.yaml:
name: shop_buys
tables:
  - name: users
    base_table:
      database: '{catalog}'
      schema: '{schema}'
      table: users
    primary_key:
      columns: [user_id]
    dimensions:
      - name: user_id
        expr: user_id
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: country
        expr: country
        data_type: TEXT
    facts:
      - name: age
        expr: age
        data_type: NUMBER
  - name: items
    base_table:
      database: '{catalog}'
      schema: '{schema}'
      table: items
    primary_key:
      columns: [item_id]
    dimensions:
      - name: item_id
        expr: item_id
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: kind
        expr: kind
        data_type: TEXT
  - name: buys
    base_table:
      database: '{catalog}'
      schema: '{schema}'
      table: buys
    primary_key:
      columns: [buy_id]
    dimensions:
      - name: buy_id
        expr: buy_id
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: user_id
        expr: user_id
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: item_id
        expr: item_id
        data_type: NUMBER
    time_dimensions:
      - name: ts
        expr: ts
        data_type: TIMESTAMP_NTZ
relationships:
  - name: buys_to_users
    left_table: buys
    right_table: users
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: user_id
        right_column: user_id
  - name: buys_to_items
    left_table: buys
    right_table: items
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: item_id
        right_column: item_id
